title: Frappe ERPNext 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 10.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or those without assigned roles, to access Payment Term settings beyond their permitted scope by sending crafted requests. The vulnerability does not require user interaction and affects confidentiality but not integrity or availability.
